ayahs.textEnglish: SAY: "I seek refuge with the Sustainer of the rising dawn,
"from the evil of aught that He has created,

ayahs.textLatin: Wa min syarri gāsiqin iżā waqab(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: "and from the evil of the black darkness whenever it descends,
"and from the evil of all human beings bent on occult endeavours,

ayahs.textLatin: Wa min syarri ḥāsidin iżā ḥasad(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: "and from the evil of the envious when he envies."
